quotes.text: I'll work to modernize our energy supply and prevent data centers from taking advantage of us, so that you pay lower utility bills.

Massive tech companies shouldn’t be allowed to come in and build loud, sprawling data centers that drain our water and raise utility costs. I’ll always stand up for working Texans, and make sure we aren’t stuck paying the bill for these out of state tech companies.

My Republican opponent is in the pocket of the big AI companies building data centers that threaten to raise our utility bills and drain our resources.

I’m running to lower your costs — and I’ll stand up to anyone to do it. https://t.co/o2WXAbuhRr

Dark money super PACs using AI to mislead voters….that’s exactly the type of thing everyone here in Texas is sick of.

I’m running to clean up corruption – meanwhile the Trump super PAC supporting my opponent is using AI to lie to voters.

https://t.co/5Av5Uzo5RA
